title: Untargeted Metabolomics: Extraction of Plasma Metabolites
author: Florence Castelli
materials: Thaw plasma samples (keep them fresh on ice)

steps.title: Sample Preparation and Aliquoting
steps.instruction: Prepare plasma samples and quality control (QC) pools for extraction.

substeps.instruction: Reorganize plasma samples in random order on dry ice.
Store samples at -80 °C until aliquoting.
Aliquot 25 µL or 50 µL of plasma depending on available volume.
Create a quality control (QC) pool by combining approximately 20 µL from all samples.
Aliquot 50 µL (or more) of the QC pool depending on available volume.
Store aliquots at -80 °C until sample extraction.

steps.title: Metabolite Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform metabolite extraction twice (once for HILIC and once for C18) using the following procedure:

substeps.instruction: Add 4 volumes (100 µL or 200 µL) of cold Methanol (LC-MS CHROMASOLV Fisher Scientific Catalog #15614740, CAS: 67-56-1) containing internal standards (IS) at 37.5 ng/mL to the plasma aliquot. Internal standards include: Dimetridazole (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #31707, CAS: 551-92-8), 2-amino-3-(3-hydroxy-5-methyl-isoxazol-4-yl)propanoic acid (AMPA) (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #A0326, CAS: 83643-88-3), 2-methyl-4-chlorophenoxyacetic acid (MCPA) (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #45555, CAS: 94-74-6), and Dinoseb (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #45453, CAS: 88-85-7).
Vortex for 5 seconds.
Incubate on ice for 1 hour and 30 minutes until complete protein precipitation.
Vortex for 5 seconds.
Collect the supernatants.
Transfer the supernatant into 0.2 mL vials.

steps.title: Supernatant Drying and Storage
steps.instruction: Dry the extracted metabolites and store them.

substeps.instruction: Dry supernatants under a nitrogen stream using a TurboVap LV (Evaporator, BIOTAGE, TurboVap® LV) at 30 °C.
Store dried extracts at -80 °C until analysis.

steps.title: Extract Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried extracts in 3 volumes of the appropriate solvent based on the intended analysis:

substeps.instruction: For ZIC-pHILIC analysis: Use Ammonium carbonate 10mM pH10.5 (prepared with Ammonia solution 25%) + External Standards (ES) / Acetonitrile (40:60, v/v).
For C18 analysis: Use ultrapure water / acetonitrile (95:5, v/v) containing 0.1% formic acid and External Standards (ES).
Vortex for 5 seconds.
Transfer the resulting supernatant into 0.2 mL vials.

steps.title: Reagent and Standard Specifications
steps.instruction: Utilize the following reagents and external standards (ES) for the resuspension and mobile phases:

substeps.instruction: Water LC-MS Chromasolv Fisher Scientific Catalog #15665350 (CAS: 7732-18-5)
AMMONIUM CARBONATE, 99.999% Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #379999 (CAS: 506-87-6)
Ammonia solution 25% for HPL Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #5438300100
Acetonitrile ULC-MS Biosolve Catalog #0001204101BS
Formic acid 99.0+% qualite LC/MS optima Fisher Scientific Catalog #10780320 (CAS: 64-18-6)

External Standards (ES) mixture of 14 standards: D-Glucose-1-13C (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #297046, CAS: 40762-22-9), L-Aspartic acid-15N (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #332135, CAS: 3715-16-0), Ethylmalonic acid (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #102687, CAS: 601-75-2), Amiloride hydrochloride hydrate (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #A7410, CAS: 2016-88-8), prednisone (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #P6254, CAS: 53-03-2), Metformine (1,1-Dimethylbiguanide hydrochloride) (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #D150959, CAS: 1115-70-4), Atropine (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #A0132, CAS: 51-55-8), Colchicine (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #C9754, CAS: 64-86-8), Imipramine hydrochloride (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #I7379, CAS: 113-52-0), Alanine-C13 (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #489867), 2-aminoanthracene (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #A38800), ampicillin (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #59349), Dihydrostreptomycin (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #D7253), and Roxithromycin (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #R4393).
Prepare 2-fold, 4-fold, and 8-fold diluted QC samples.
